newsitem.title: UK: Desperate parents in UK queue for Buzz Lightyear.
newsitem.headline: Desperate parents in UK queue for Buzz Lightyear.

text.p: Desperate British parents queued eagerly up on Friday when the Disney store in London got a surprise consignment of Buzz Lightyear robots -- the most sought after Christmas present of the year.
Children have clamoured for the robot doll in the runup to Christmas but most toystores across Europe have sold out and warned that fresh stocks cannot be expected until December 28.
"Despite our best efforts, we just could not forecast the demand," said a spokesman for Disney Stores (Europe).
"I think the real secret is that the toy is such a good replica that children actually believe they're getting the real Buzz Lightyear and that he will start walking around when they are asleep."
A passing bus conductor was so desperate to get a Buzz Lightyear for his three-year-old son that he leapt off his bus and stopped the traffic. But he was too late. They had all sold out again.
